settings.title: Yuzu spritz
settings.description: Yuzu Lime, a splash of dry vermouth and plenty of ice. Bright, a little bitter, and done in two minutes.
settings.ingredients:
Lots of ice
1 can of Tangelo Yuzu Lime, cold
1 oz dry vermouth, or leave it out
1 strip of lime peel
settings.steps:
Fill a tall glass to the top with ice.
Add the vermouth, then pour the soda in slowly down the side so it keeps its fizz.
Stir once, gently.
Twist the lime peel over the glass, drop it in and drink it while it's loud.
settings.tip: Put the can in the freezer for ten minutes before you pour.
